summary: Build school improvement plans, dashboards, and governance confidence in 5 days. Practical, advanced training for education leaders.
lede: School leadership training supports principals, deputies, department heads, and school support professionals in assessing performance and planning practical improvements. Participants learn to build self-evaluation tools and improvement plans, monitor teaching and staff performance, oversee safeguarding and operational risks, and present evidence through dashboards and reports for school leaders and governing bodies.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who lead, manage, coordinate, or support school performance, governance, and improvement planning.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in a school, college, training centre, or education support function. Familiarity with school operations, teacher coordination, learner data, and basic reporting is expected; no coding is required. A laptop is recommended for working on templates, dashboards, and planning tools. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational level, with hands-on practice in school improvement planning, data review, and leadership reporting.
